Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor sector, as SMH is showing weakness and SOXL is deeply in the red. Data center stocks are also under pressure.

Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged tech book is facing headwinds; focus on managing risk in your most vulnerable positions.
plays: Trim SMCI: It's down significantly and marked SELL. Consider reducing exposure given the negative PnL and its status.
Trim SOXL: Down over 55%, this leveraged ETF is a major drag. Re-evaluate your position size and risk tolerance here.
Consider SOXS: Scanner shows a LONG setup (entry 45.53-45.48, stop 44.35). This is a short ETF, potentially hedging some of your chip exposure if you're concerned.
